statement: ∀ (N Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] (a : ℕ → ℂ), (∑ r : ZMod Q, ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), a n * ZMod.stdAddChar (r * (n : ZMod Q))‖ ^ 2) ≤ (N + Q : ℝ) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ‖a n‖ ^ 2

plain_statement.zh: 有限大筛法：ZMod Q 上 N+1 项指数和均方不超过 (N+Q) 倍系数能量。
plain_statement.en: Finite large sieve: the mean square of N+1 exponential sums on ZMod Q is at most (N+Q) times the coefficient energy.

brief.zh: 用 ZMod 的 Parseval 与按余类分纤维的 Cauchy–Schwarz；不依赖素数，是 Type-II 色散估计的基础。
brief.en: Use ZMod Parseval and Cauchy–Schwarz on residue-class fibers; this is prime-independent and supports Type-II dispersion estimates.
